subject: Post-demo: budget sensitivity, target $/1M & suggested model split
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sima Patel <sima.patel@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: budget sensitivity, target $/1M & suggested model split

Hi Sima —

Thanks again for the demo time this morning. Quick recap and a concrete ask to unblock internal procurement: we put together an initial token-cost worksheet (attached) and a recommended model allocation based on what you shared about use cases. Please confirm the rough monthly token volume below or send a corrected number so we can finalize pricing options.

Summary (pilot / expected steady-state):
- Pilot window: 3 months, expected avg tokens/month: 40M (range 30M–50M)
- Steady-state target: 350M tokens/month within 12 months (range 250M–500M)

Current recommended model mix (by token volume):
- Chat / conversational generation (primary UX): 65%
- Embeddings (semantic search & personalization) : 28%
- Rerank / specialized reranking requests: 7%

Initial unit economics we used in the sheet (blended examples):
- Pilot blended target: $1,100 per 1M tokens (pilot rate; includes startup support credits)
- Scale target: $720 per 1M tokens (committed tier, 12-month minimum)
- Sensitivity: +/−15% per-1M tokens for ±20% change in model mix or 30% change in average generation length

Per-model guidance (examples in attached tab):
- Chat: baseline $1,350/1M in pilot; $800/1M at scale with reserved capacity and batching
- Embeddings: baseline $420/1M; $300/1M at scale (quantized embed model options available)
- Rerank: baseline $2,300/1M; $1,400/1M at scale (heavy compute per-token)

Ask: can you confirm (by EOD Wed) the expected tokens/month for pilot and whether Veridian is open to a 12-month commit for the scale discount? Once we have that I’ll circulate a short MAP (mutual action plan) and a pricing term sheet.

Next steps we propose:
1) Veridian confirms pilot tokens and commit preference
2) Redwood sends MAP + pricing table (we’ll include sensitivity scenarios)
3) Technical kickoff: embed/rerank demo with your search team (we can do next week)

Attachment: veridian_initial_estimate.xlsx (tabs: assumptions, per-model costing, sensitivity)

Thanks —

Tessa Morgan
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
(t) 415-555-0199
https://redwood.com

----
From: Sima Patel <sima.patel@veridianhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Joel Ramirez <joel.ramirez@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 11:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: budget sensitivity, target $/1M & suggested model split

Tessa —

Appreciate the clear breakdown and the spreadsheet. Quick answers from our side:
- Pilot tokens/month: closer to 45M (we expect a slightly higher engagement during onboarding)
- Steady state: our internal forecast is 300M–420M (conservative/optimistic)
- Regarding 12-month commit: procurement prefers 12 months with quarterly volume reviews; Joel and I need to confirm internal budget holder sign-off but team is generally favorable to committed pricing.

A few clarifying questions:
1) The $720/1M scale target — is that conditional on a specific minimum monthly commit, or is it a blended outcome once we hit 350M?
2) For embeddings, are the quantized options functionally identical for your recommended use (semantic search + user vectors), or is there quality tradeoff we should evaluate?

Can we schedule a short call Thurs morning ET to go over MAP and any legal must-haves? Joel will join.

Thanks,
Sima
Head of Product | Veridian Health

----
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sima Patel <sima.patel@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: budget sensitivity, target $/1M & suggested model split

Sima — thanks for the quick headcount. Answers inline below and added a second attachment (MAP draft) with the thresholds called out.

Q1: $720/1M scale target details:
- That target assumes a sustained monthly commit of >= 300M tokens for 12 months OR a three-tiered sliding scale where the blended per-1M falls to $720 once total monthly volume exceeds 350M. We can spell this out in the MAP. If you prefer a firm minimum (e.g., 300M), we can do that too — it just affects the committed discount curve.

Q2: embeddings quantization note:
- Quantized embeddings (8-bit/4-bit) are typically indistinguishable for dense vector search for most customers. We recommend running a >1k-pair precision check — we’ll provide a short eval harness to validate on your data. If you need exact parity for downstream classification models, we can allocate a non-quantized model for that subset.

Updated action items in MAP_draft_v2.pdf (attached):
- Pricing tier options (Pilot vs. Committed 12mo vs. Volume-blended)
- Technical validation plan (3-step: sample embed eval, rerank A/B on historic queries, latency check)
- Legal/Procurement: standard SaaS addendum + data residency checkbox

Proposed call: Thu 24 Aug, 10:00–10:30am ET — does that work?

If yes, I’ll book and add Ben (pricing) and Marissa (CS) — Ben can walk through variant routing options to reduce cost (e.g., cheaper chat model for low-risk flows, cached prefixes).

Best,
Tessa

----
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sima Patel <sima.patel@veridianhealth.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: budget sensitivity, target $/1M & suggested model split

Sima — quick note from my side. Agree with Tessa’s approach; small optimization suggestions before Thursday:
- Start pilot routing: default to chat-medium for interactive flows (cost-conscious) and route long-form generation to chat-large only when response length estimate > 200 tokens.
- For embeddings, run quantized vs. fp16 on 2k sample queries; if precision loss <1.5% we recommend switching to quantized for all embed traffic.
- Rerank volume looks small (7%) — consider batching rerank calls where possible to reduce per-call overhead.

If you confirm Thu 10am ET I’ll prep a short slide with the expected cost outcomes for the pilot vs. committed scenarios.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Sr. Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
